class.name: NetwQuantizeQuaternion
class.description: Sends three of the four components, and rebuilds the largest one. Any rotation takes [code]2 + bit_count * 3[/code] bits. [codeblock] var q := NetwQuantizeQuaternion.new().bits(10) [/codeblock]

method.name: bits
method.description: Sets [member bit_count] and returns this quantizer.
